name: Wink Danang Riverside, Unscripted by Hyatt
short_description: A 357-room riverside hotel on the Han River with a rooftop infinity pool and bar, offering budget-friendly rates for a World of Hyatt property in Da Nang.
ai_summary: Wink Danang Riverside sits on Tran Hung Dao Street along the Han River in Son Tra, with 287 space-smart rooms plus 70 Wink Live suites and serviced residences, and a rooftop infinity pool and bar as its signature feature. It joined World of Hyatt through the December 2025 Wink Hotels partnership under the Unscripted by Hyatt brand. Guest reviews describe a solid, well-equipped budget option -- a self-service laundry, well-equipped gym, and staff who recognize elite status stand out -- but rooms run small, some reviewers find the finishes cheaper-feeling than comparable Marriott or IHG budget brands, and the rooftop pool can close for private events.

core_facts.address: 351 Tran Hung Dao Street, An Hai Trung Ward, Son Tra District, Da Nang, Vietnam
elite_benefits: Complimentary full breakfast daily for World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members at properties without a dedicated club lounge, per World of Hyatt program terms
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

pros: Rooftop infinity pool and bar overlooking the Han River
Self-service laundry facility and a well-equipped gym, unusual extras at this price point
Staff recognize World of Hyatt elite status and greet guests by name
Breakfast included, with river views from some rooms
Notably budget-friendly cash rates for a World of Hyatt property in Da Nang
cons: Rooms run small, cramped with more than one or two suitcases
Some finishes feel cheaper than comparable Marriott or IHG budget-brand hotels
The rooftop pool can close for private or ticketed events
Street noise reported despite higher-floor rooms
research_highlights: The rooftop infinity pool and river views draw consistent praise
The self-service laundry and gym are repeatedly called out as unusual, welcome extras
Value for money is a recurring theme, especially versus comparable riverside hotels
research_watchouts: Room sizes are consistently described as tight
The rooftop pool's occasional closure for events has disappointed some guests expecting pool access

faqs.question: Does Wink Danang Riverside have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- a rooftop infinity pool and bar overlooking the Han River is the property's signature feature, though it can close periodically for private or ticketed events.

faqs.question: How big are the rooms at Wink Danang Riverside?
faqs.answer: On the small side -- guest reviews consistently describe the standard rooms as cramped once more than one or two suitcases are involved, which is typical of the budget-friendly Wink brand's space-smart room category.

reviews.title: Is Wink Danang Riverside Worth It? Review of New Hyatt Brand
reviews.summary: Calls it a solid budget pick for Hyatt loyalists, praising the gym, self-service laundry, and staff who remembered the guest's name, but flagging tiny rooms, cheaper-feeling materials, and a rooftop pool closed for a ticketed event.
